Resources nodes are parts of the game world from which a player character can obtain resources. There are two main kinds of resource nodes: * Profession nodes that can by looted by gathering or harvesting, yielding raw ingredient items usable by professions or items required by quests, such as herbs or mineral veins. These are objects which can be directly interacted with. * Resource nodes or 'bases' found in resource race battlegrounds. These grant resource points over time to whichever team currently dominates the base, either through directly capturing the node or simply by having a superior number of players in the area. For more information, see Bases.

The term resist means that a player, mob, or NPC was not, or only to a lesser extent, affected by a spell or elemental attack. Full resists completely negate the effect and have the same effect as Immune. Partial resists only reduce the damage received by a percentage; these can only occur with non-binary spells. There are two sources for spell resists. Firstly, the level difference between the caster and their target determines the spell hit chance. A spell which misses its target results in a full resist, whereas partial resists cannot occur. Spell hit rating decreases the chance of getting a resist due to this difference. This page discusses resistance buffs. Note: Player-cast group buffs do not stack. Paladin's Resistance Aura or Shaman's Elemental Resistance Totem does not stack with shale spider's Embrace of the Shale Spider, Paladin's Blessing of Kings, Druid's Mark of the Wild, Priest's Shadow Protection, or Hunter's Aspect of the Wild. Solo buffs such as Mage Armor and non-player-cast buffs do stack, however.

The Reputation tab of the character info window shows a list of factions known by a character and the current reputation level out of a possible total. Mists of Pandaria introduced bonus reputation that is available for purchase at revered. The bonus reputation doubles the amount of reputation earned for that specific reputation. Unlocking bonus reputation for one faction applies for all players on the single account. Although, bonus reputation was never implemented in future expansions and only applies to Mists of Pandaria reputations. Grand Commendations can be used to increase reputation gains with a faction account-wide and will be indicated by a gold arrow in the interface. Legion intro

In some installations, rotating the mouse wheel moves the view forward (so the player character is no longer visible) but rotating it into opposite direction does not return it backwards. The actual reason of this strange behavior is that "Mouse wheel up" is mapped to the corresponding command and "Mouse wheel down" in not. Remap properly (ESC, "Key bindings", "Zoom in" and "Zoom out") and you will no longer need any cryptic scripts.

Resilient Outcast's Sabatons are a quest reward from Sulthis' Stone (quest).
Resilient Outcast's Boots are a quest reward from Aided Escape.
Resilient Outcast's Greaves are a quest reward from Stolen Satchels.
Resilient Outcast's Wristguards are a quest reward from Stolen Satchels.
Resilient Outcast's Handguards are a quest reward from The Little Ones.
Resilient Outcast's Breeches are a quest reward from The Little Ones.
Resilient Outcast's Handlers are a quest reward from The Great Cranium Caper.
Residue Detector is provided as an objective for Let the Residue Lead You.
Repurposed Custodians are nightborne constructs located in the Horde camp in Xibala in Zuldazar. One is seen holding a leaf over a sleeping Nightborne Scholar.
The Resonance Locator is a reward from Finding a Key. Once obtained, the mission Tracking the Worldvein becomes available.
Resistance Fighters are humans located in the Old Town in the Vision of Stormwind.
Resilient Souls have a chance to drop from mobs in the Vale of Eternal Twilight and Vision of the Twisting Sands.
The Resilient Outcast's Gloves are a quest reward from The Source of the Problem.
Resonating Crystal Scimitar drops from the Avatar of Sethraliss in the Temple of Sethraliss.
Resonating Chests were located in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Residue Evil is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating Executor Tarvold after slaying 8 Forlorn Captives with the effects of Residue in Sanguine Depths on Mythic difficulty.

Rerdyn is a nightborne poet. He, along with his assistant Glandren, was present to witness the poetry contest between First Arcanist Thalyssra and Lor'themar Theron. He wished to speak with Thalyssra about her piece (Spirit of the Moment) but grew annoyed at Lor'themar after Thalyssra denied his request and went to speak with the Regent-Lord privately.
Resonating Anima Cores are created by combining five Resonating Anima Mote.
Repurposed Abomination Choker was a quest reward from The Ones in Charge. The item's ID was reused by Reclaimed Maldraxxi Choker.
Resounding Protection is an Azerite trait available to all classes.

Reservoir Anima is a special form of anima used to purchase covenant sanctum upgrades (alongside Redeemed Souls) and a few cosmetic rewards. Players can turn in their collected anima from world quests and callings for an Emblem of Renown once a week in exchange for 1000 anima on the weekly quest Replenish the Reservoir.
Resistance Boots were an objective of Worm Food during the alpha.
Rescued Urchins are human children located in Tiragarde Sound. They are former workers of Ashvane Foundry.
Researcher Au'daluk is a broker located in the near all the other secondary profession trainers in the Hall of Shapes in Oribos.
Resonant Misery are manifestations located in Gorgoa: River of Souls in the Maw.
Resonate Maldracite Crystal was replaced by Intriguing Ancient Relic during development.
